hypotheses.statement: The settlement-worker concurrency increase from 8 to 32 workers at 15:55:00Z caused database connection pool exhaustion because the pool size (20) was insufficient for the increased worker count.

The feature-flag service token expiry at 15:59:00Z caused 401 invalid_token responses from flags.internal, which made the settlement-worker fail closed when unable to read the settlement_v2_enabled flag.
The two faults (connection pool exhaustion and token expiry) were independent and coincidental, occurring four minutes apart, and both contributed to the elevated settlement failure ratio.

observed_facts.statement: Configuration change at 15:55:00Z raised settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers. The database connection pool size was left at 20 and is not derived from the worker count.
settlement-worker: database connection pool exhausted from 15:58:10Z. Pool size 20, checked-out 20, queue depth rising. Errors: pool_timeout after 5000ms. Affects approximately 0.38 of attempts.

The service token settlement-worker uses for flags.internal was issued for 90 days on 2025-11-13 and expired at 15:59:00Z on 2026-02-11. Its renewal was not automated. This expiry is unrelated to the concurrency change applied four minutes earlier.

settlement-worker: calls to flags.internal returning 401 invalid_token from 15:59:02Z. The worker fails closed when it cannot read the settlement_v2_enabled flag. Affects approximately 0.31 of attempts, overlapping with pool_timeout failures on some attempts.
Alert settlement-failures fired at 16:00:44Z. Settlement attempts failing reached 0.61 against an objective of 0.02. The alert did not clear until 18:12:30Z.
INC-2201 opened at 16:05:00Z, severity 1, title 'Settlements failing'. The ticket records no settlement value at risk and no such figure was added before resolution.
settlement-worker: connection pool raised to 64 at 17:20:15Z. pool_timeout errors stopped. Settlement failure ratio fell from 0.61 to 0.29 and did not fall further.
Series settlement_failure_ratio: 0.61 from 16:00Z, stepping down to 0.29 at 17:20Z and to 0.004 at 18:12Z. The series shows two distinct step changes, each aligned with a different remediation.
Responder R: 'Pool is at 64 now and pool_timeout is gone, so we should be recovered. Why are we still failing 29% of settlements?'

Responder S: 'Because there are two faults, not one. The pool exhaustion came from the concurrency change at 15:55. Separately, the flags.internal token expired at 15:59. They started four minutes apart and neither explains the other.'
settlement-worker: a replacement token for flags.internal was installed at 18:12:10Z. 401 responses stopped and the settlement failure ratio fell from 0.29 to 0.004.
Responder S: 'Both are fixed. Nobody has established why pool size is not derived from worker concurrency, and nobody has audited which other service tokens are on manual renewal.'

open_questions.missing_evidence: Documentation or configuration management records explaining the design decision
open_questions.question: Why is the database connection pool size not derived from the worker concurrency?

open_questions.missing_evidence: Inventory of service tokens with their renewal policies and expiration dates
open_questions.question: Which other service tokens are on manual renewal and when do they expire?

summary: Incident dual-cause-payments involved two independent, coincidental faults: (1) database connection pool exhaustion due to increased worker concurrency without corresponding pool size adjustment, and (2) feature-flag service token expiry causing authentication failures. Both contributed to elevated settlement failures, requiring sequential fixes to fully resolve.

timeline.statement: Configuration change raised settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers; database connection pool size remained at 20.
Database connection pool exhausted; pool_timeout errors affecting ~0.38 of attempts.
Calls to flags.internal returning 401 invalid_token; worker fails closed when unable to read flag, affecting ~0.31 of attempts.
Alert settlement-failures fired; settlement failure ratio reached 0.61 (objective 0.02).
Connection pool raised to 64; pool_timeout errors stopped; failure ratio fell from 0.61 to 0.29.
Replacement token for flags.internal installed; 401 responses stopped; failure ratio fell from 0.29 to 0.004.
